llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及涂层植入物与骨整合，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或LPBF制造。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no as-built surface morphology.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究不同离子掺杂羟基磷灰石涂层对骨质疏松大鼠骨整合的影响。
summary_zh.method: 在钛植入物上制备锌、镁、锶掺杂的羟基磷灰石涂层，植入骨质疏松大鼠股骨。
summary_zh.result: 锌和锶掺杂涂层显著促进了骨整合，镁掺杂效果较差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过大鼠体内植入实验和组织学分析验证。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the osseointegration efficacy of zinc, magnesium, and strontium-incorporated hydroxyapatite coatings on titanium implants in osteopenic rats.
summary_en.method: Hydroxyapatite coatings doped with Zn, Mg, or Sr were deposited on titanium implants and implanted into the femurs of osteopenic rats.
summary_en.result: Zn- and Sr-doped coatings significantly enhanced osseointegration compared to pure hydroxyapatite, while Mg-doped coatings showed inferior performance.
summary_en.validation: In vivo animal study with histological and biomechanical evaluation.

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification and visualization for func- tional random variables
papers.abstract: In the framework of industrial risk assessment studies, the reliability of a component is evaluated during accidental conditions. A numerical model provides the thermal-hydraulic (T-H) loading of this compo-nent subjected to highly hypothetical conditions. Then, a numerical model for the mechanical analysis of components and structures (called hereafter the T-M code), taking as input the T-H loading, calculates the breaking strength of the component and the thermo-mechanical actual applied load. From these two elements, a safety criterion is deduced. Under the hypothesis of accidental conditions, the component behavior depends on many uncertain parameters, related to the initial plant conditions or to the safety system characteristics. These uncertain parameters are input variables of the T-H code. They can be of various types: scalar, functional, categorical... It can be important to assess how these uncertainties can affect the code forecasts. To deal with all these uncertainties, computer experiment methodologies like uncertainty propagation and sensitivity analysis are useful. As the T-H code is much more time expensive than the T-M code, the uncertainties on the results of the T-H code which are of functional type, are directly characterized, so that uncertainty propagation and sensitivity analysis can be applied on the T-M code. llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注工业热工水力代码的不确定性量化，与生物力学植入物代理建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: No surrogate model for FEA, no implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估工业事故条件下组件可靠性，需量化热工水力代码输入的不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 对热工水力代码的功能型输出进行不确定性表征，用于后续力学分析。
summary_zh.result: 提出功能型随机变量的不确定性传播与敏感性分析方法。
summary_zh.validation: 未提供具体验证，仅理论框架。

summary_en.motivation: To assess component reliability under accidental conditions by quantifying uncertainties in thermal-hydraulic code inputs.
summary_en.method: Characterize uncertainties of functional outputs from thermal-hydraulic codes for propagation to thermo-mechanical analysis.
summary_en.result: Proposed a framework for uncertainty propagation and sensitivity analysis of functional random variables.
summary_en.validation: No validation provided; purely theoretical framework.
